name: g1_explore_room_closeout
_note: Closeout revalidation of Milestone B (experiments/g1_explore_room.py) at the committed code, on fresh seeds. Same room generators, time budget and step budget as g1_explore_room.json. Seed ranges are half-open [a, b): nominal 1300-1319, shifted 2300-2309, no_cabinet 3100-3109; verified by grep to appear in no config, result, test or script (earlier: nominal 0-9, 1000-1019, 1100-1119, 1200-1219; shifted 2000-2009, 2100-2109, 2200-2209; no_cabinet 3000-3005). Nominal runs the 'gain' frontier policy only; shifted and no_cabinet run 'gain' and 'nearest' on the same rooms (paired). The revalidation claim is for the current code only; historical numbers in results/g1_explore_room* are separate and are not rescored. Nothing is tuned after seeing results.

gates._note: Success and refusal gates are on the gain policy; false claims and falls count all rows. no_cabinet refusal is gated under the original scorer (no claim and no fall); it is additionally reported strictly, excluding phantom-driven refusals (refusal_category phantom_or_unreachable_candidate, or phantom_handles > 0), which do not count as correct.

reported_not_gated: contacts by body class (foot_furniture, hand_handle, hand_furniture, other): episodes, ticks, peak force, last-3-s flag
strict success: success with no contact other than hand_handle
phantom_handles per episode; refusal category counts

frontier_comparison.pairs: shifted and no_cabinet, same seed, gain vs nearest
frontier_comparison.primary_metric: sim_s: simulated seconds to terminal outcome of the episode (claim, refusal or budget stop), mean of (gain - nearest); negative favours gain
frontier_comparison.interval: paired bootstrap over pairs, 10000 resamples, rng seed 0, 95 percentile interval
frontier_comparison.divergence: a go_to decision where gain and nearest policies, applied to the same state, choose different frontiers; counted from the gain arm's recorded decisions over all paired episodes (the nearest arm and pairs with at least one divergence are reported too)
frontier_comparison.claim_rule: gain is claimed better only if the primary-metric interval excludes 0 in gain's favour (upper bound < 0); otherwise no claim
